comments.text:
The game takes place in 1979, which sorta explains doing this all for $25. It's still, like, not a whole lot, but then again, Fazbear Entertainment has always been about giving such low quantities of money [$120 per week in 1992 for FNAF 1, $100.50 per week in 1987 for FNAF 2]. It appears we're always playing as characters who aren't doing very well financially in this series. I mean, Mike and Jeremy literally circle job applications on their newspapers as if to say "HOLY COW I HAVE A CHANCE!!" in the first two games, and Arnold is doing bad enough to be working with Fazbear Entertainment, so it makes a lot of sense.
Also, Arnold didn't know about the Mimic. For all he knew, he just assumed it was going to be a simple "get in, grab it, get out" situation.
